claims.claim: The game loop, from the official game description: throw food as far as you can; attract and collect animals from different areas; earn money from your animals; buy better food to attract rarer animals; train on pull-up stands to gain Throw Power; reach new areas with stronger and rarer animals.
claims.notes: Guide quotes the official game description's six steps (checked Nov 17, 2026).

claims.claim: Your animals keep making money while you are offline.
claims.notes: Pro Game Guides and games.gg, reported by the guide (checked Nov 17, 2026).

claims.claim: 17 biomes: Forest, Savanna, Desert, Jungle, Ocean, Mountains, Taiga, Winter, Prehistoric Forest, Deep Waters, Hell, Ancient Ruins, Mythical Paradise, Shadow Realm, Harvest Fields, Phantom Harbor and Nuclear Wasteland.
claims.notes: Beebom and Timesaver (from IGN's index) count 17 biomes, reported by the guide (checked Nov 17, 2026). The narration calls them 'areas', the game's own word in its description.
